relatedEntities.notes: Famous large-scale biocatalytic amination case study

relatedEntities.name: Sitagliptin phosphate tablets
relatedEntities.notes: Common salt form for oral solid dose — DP process separate

properties.appearance: White to off-white solid (free base / salt forms)

hazards.notes: Fluorinated organics and potent API handling policies site-dependent.

applications: Type 2 diabetes oral therapy (clinical use not covered here)
overview: Sitagliptin is a classic process-chemistry teaching molecule because industrial manufacture shifted toward a highly efficient biocatalytic asymmetric amination, reducing waste versus earlier rhodium-catalyzed routes. Dual-view routes below contrast biocatalytic vs chemical themes for MSAT / process education.
manufacturingSummary: Preferred modern packages emphasize enzymatic transamination to install the chiral amine, followed by coupling/isolation to sitagliptin free base or phosphate salt. Earlier chemical asymmetric hydrogenation packages remain literature-relevant for comparison.

environmentBaseline.atmosphere: N2 for air-sensitive catalysts where used
environmentBaseline.containment: Potent compound handling for API finishing

ehsHighlights: Biocatalyst vs heavy-metal catalyst trade-offs (waste / recovery)

routes.name: Biocatalytic asymmetric amination (industrial preferred theme)
routes.summary: Prochiral ketone intermediate converted with engineered transaminase to the desired chiral amine; isolate and finish to API / salt.
advantages: Improved green metrics vs early Rh routes (literature)

steps.title: Enzymatic amination
steps.description: Charge ketone intermediate with transaminase and amine donor under controlled pH and temperature. Drive conversion and e.e. to IPC targets.
steps.mechanismNotes: PLP-dependent transaminases transfer nitrogen from a donor amine to the prochiral ketone, establishing the R-amine stereocenter under evolutionary enzyme engineering.
steps.scaleNotes: Mass transfer and enzyme lifetime dominate scale-up for immobilized systems.

steps.title: Workup, salt formation, isolation
steps.description: Separate enzyme/biocatalyst, extract or crystallize free base or form phosphate salt; dry to specification.

scaleUp.labToKilo: Validate enzyme reuse cycles and workup emulsion control
scaleUp.greenChemistryNotes: Often cited for E-factor improvement vs early chemical routes

sourceRefs.note: Educational outline of industrial biocatalytic theme — not a site package

sourceRefs.label: Process chemistry reviews on sitagliptin biocatalysis

routes.name: Chemical asymmetric route theme (literature / historical industrial)
routes.summary: Asymmetric hydrogenation or other chemical chiral induction to install the amine stereocenter; coupling and isolation.
disadvantages: Often higher waste intensity in early packages

materials.name: Chiral Rh or other metal catalyst (historical packages)

steps.title: Asymmetric hydrogenation / chemical chiral step
steps.description: Reduce prochiral intermediate under chiral catalysis with controlled H2 pressure and temperature; monitor e.e. and conversion.

environment.notes: Hydrogen safety and metal recovery mandatory

steps.title: Coupling / isolation
steps.description: Complete remaining fragment couplings if required; crystallize API or salt.

disclaimer: Educational process scaffold highlighting biocatalytic vs chemical themes. Not GMP. Not prescribing information.
